item.title: Spring weather emerges with record highs possible in Houston by Thursday
item.description: We are putting the threat of frosts and freezes in the rear view mirror as temperatures make a big run up into the 80s.

item.title: Court says the IRS can continue to share immigrants' taxpayer data with ICE
item.description: A federal court on Tuesday rejected a request from an immigrant rights group to temporarily block the IRS from sharing certain taxpayer data.

item.title: City of Houston seeks additional funding methods to combat illegal dumping
item.description: The City of Houston said its illegal dumping program is out of money, and the timing couldn't be worse for some neighbors.

item.title: Parents say district lacks transparency as HISD pushes to fund HISD Now and cut misinformation
item.description: HISD leaders propose spending $2 million on HISD Now in the 2025-26 district improvement plan, an in-house communication project that creates content produced by district employees.

item.title: Suspect charged with murder in crash that left woman dead and 3-year-old boy injured, HPD says
item.description: A suspect has been charged in a crash that left a woman dead and a child hospitalized in northwest Houston on Tuesday, according to the Houston Police Department.

item.title: Firm representing Toyota Center to pay $100k for not meeting court order in case of paralyzed man
item.description: A family has filed a lawsuit after they say their loved one was paralyzed after a fall outside of the Toyota Center four years ago.

item.title: City of Houston's controversial homeless 'super hub' set to open in June, according to officials
item.description: The controversial homeless "super hub" approved by the Houston City Council is still moving forward, though it's now a few months behind schedule.

item.title: Man shot and killed at Willowbrook-area apartment complex, HPD says
item.description: A man was shot and killed in an apartment complex in the Willowbrook area near Cypress Creek High School on Tuesday, HPD said.

item.title: Montgomery County man accused of secretly giving drug to unborn child's mother, authorities say
item.description: A Montgomery County man is behind bars, accused of secretly drugging a woman in an alleged attempt to end her pregnancy. Now, his mother says there is more to the story.

item.title: Takeaways from Trump's State of the Union address: Sales mode on economy, heavy on patriotism
item.description: President Trump used his State of the Union address to sell a booming America, even as voters worry about the economy.
